requirement_text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points qualifies for admission to both bachelor's in engineering and Bachelor of Sciences programmes. IB DP Course Results or IB Certificate with at least 18 points, minimum grade 3 in all six subjects, and at least three Higher Level subjects qualify for bachelor's in engineering programmes.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Eligibility floor, not a competitive band -- 24 IB points is the minimum passing diploma. Contrast Trinity College Dublin, whose published IB figures (30-40) are competitive bands. Storing both as 'IB requirement' without that distinction would make DTU look eight times easier than it is.

requirement_text: DTU only accepts IB retakes if the original exam was not passed.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Named provenance exclusion on an academic qualification rather than a test score. A student who retook an already-passed IB to raise their points is assessed on the original result. Numerically identical diplomas, different outcomes -- exactly the defect class in scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md section 3, and the first instance the corpus has of it applying to a school diploma rather than a standardised test.
researcher_notes: Generalises the excluded-provenance field beyond test scores: it belongs on grade requirements too.

requirement_text: Minimum score 88 or 4.5 (for exams taken after the 21st of January)
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: DTU handles the ETS rescale but dates it as 'the 21st of January' with NO YEAR. The intended cutover is unmistakably 21 January 2026, but the page does not say so, and the rule as written will read as ambiguous every January from now on. Neither figure carries a subtest requirement, so unlike Lund and Glasgow both halves remain satisfiable -- the defect is in the boundary, not the thresholds.
researcher_notes: A useful middle case between Sweden's exemplary dual-scale rows and Lund's silent legacy-only row: the institution knows about the rescale and still leaves the scale boundary underdetermined. Argues that the scale qualifier needs its own date field rather than relying on prose.

requirement_text: IELTS Academic -- Minimum 6.5 points. ... DTU does not accept IELTS One Skill Retake results.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Directly opposite to University Admissions in Sweden, which accepts IELTS One Skill Retake (Academic). Not a conflict -- two institutions in different countries are each authoritative about their own admission -- but it is proof that the accepted-variant list cannot be modelled as a property of the test.

requirement_text: The verification of TOEFL and IELTS tests expires after 2 years and will not be accepted if they are non-verifiable on 5 July.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: A recency rule with an explicit anchor -- verifiability is measured at 5 July, not at the application date and not at programme start. Edinburgh anchors to 'prior to entry' and to 'the start date of this programme'; DTU anchors to a fixed calendar day. A max-age field without an anchor field cannot express these three as different rules.
researcher_notes: Note the polarity is opposite to Sweden's: DTU makes non-verifiability a hard bar, where University Admissions treats the 2-year figure as overridable if verification still works. Same underlying ETS/IELTS mechanics, opposite institutional rule.

requirement_text: Note! Meeting the English B level subject requirement from your upper secondary education does not exempt you from taking an English test.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Explicitly closes the substitution a student would reasonably assume. Recorded because an evaluator that treats subject-level English as satisfying the language requirement would return 'met' where DTU returns 'not eligible'.

requirement_text: Please note that all non-EU/EEA applicants are required to pay an application fee of € 100 before your application is processed. ... Please note that your application will not be processed until we have received your application fee payment.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Denmark charges the application fee at institution level (DTU, EUR 100), where Sweden and Finland charge it nationally (SEK 900 / EUR 100 once, covering all applications). A student applying to three Danish universities pays three times; to three Swedish ones, once. That difference is invisible if the fee is stored as a scalar on the institution.

requirement_text: The tuition fee at DTU is €15,000 per academic year. You pay the tuition fee up front one semester at a time at €7,500 per semester. ... EU/EEA citizens are not required to pay tuition fee to enroll in degree programmes in Denmark as their tuition fee is covered by the Danish state. ... DTU does not offer tuition fee waivers or any other funding at undergraduate level.
source_authority_note: dtu.dk is the official domain of the Technical University of Denmark (website_url on the matched universities row is https://dtu.dk). Danish national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: The no-waiver statement matters as much as the amount: Aalto, KTH and NTNU all differ on whether a fee-liable student can compete for a waiver, and DTU's answer at undergraduate level is a flat no.
